caseNameFull: Harry L. Burgoyne, Trustee v. Patrick E. McKillip
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit. Motion to dismiss or affirm and petition for certiorari submitted April 3, 1911.
attorneys: Mr. C. C. Flansburg and Mr. Robert Ramsey for the appellants and petitioners., Mr. Francis A. Brogan for the appellees and respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. First National Bank v. Estherville, 215 U. S. 341, 346; Rogers v. Clark Iron Co., 217 U. S. 589. Petition for a writ of certiorari denied.
